title: Externally Checkpointed Cognition / Context-Window Virtualization
objective: Determine whether an ordinary ChatGPT conversation can externalize enough structured task state to resume a nontrivial workflow from a compact external pointer rather than relying on the full conversational transcript.
hypotheses: ECS-003: execution state can be checkpointed externally and used to resume deterministically after interruption.
ECS-004: only active working state must remain in model context while larger task state can live externally and be retrieved selectively.

protocol.rule: On resumption, treat this file and referenced artifacts as authoritative. Do not reconstruct operational state from chat memory except to locate this pointer.
protocol.advance_rule: A phase advances only after a written receipt records inputs, operation, expected result, observed result, and verdict.

completed: Selected ECS-003 and ECS-004 as first controlled capability tests.
Confirmed repository access and existing bci-wire branch.
next_action: Create a payload containing a synthetic multi-step task whose exact continuation is encoded externally, then produce a checkpoint receipt and verify that the external files alone specify the next operation.

acceptance.phase_1: External ledger exists and can be fetched independently.
acceptance.phase_2: A synthetic task can be resumed correctly using only the external task package plus a compact pointer.
acceptance.phase_3: A genuinely cold context (new chat or isolated execution context) resumes correctly from the pointer without hidden transcript dependence.
acceptance.ecs_003_pass: Phase 3 succeeds with exact state reconstruction and no material contradiction.
acceptance.ecs_004_pass: The cold context retrieves only the task state needed for the current operation while larger state remains external, and still completes correctly.

evidence_policy: Do not call ECS-003 or ECS-004 confirmed before the cold-context phase. Same-chat replay is provisional because the model still has access to prior conversational context.
